Genetic diversity was analyzed by software Powermarker V3.25 for each SNP. As shown in Table 4, the gene diversity (He), heterozygosity (H0), and polymorphism information content (PIC) of the 10 SNP ranged 0.4394–0.4991, 0.0830–0.5233 and 0.3161–0.3746 respectively.
